test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man sold an oven for ₹8,875 and made a profit of 25% in the process. What would have been his profit or loss percent (up to two decimal places), had he sold it for ₹6,937?
solution:
Given:

The man sold an oven for ₹8,875 an made a profit of 25% in the process. 

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Profit%

Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the oven be c.

According to the question,

c + c × 25% = 8875

⇒ 1.25c = 8875

⇒ c = 8875/1.25

⇒ c = 7100

Now, loss% = {{7100 - 6937} over 7100} times 100\%

⇒ 2.2957% ≈ 2.30%

∴ His loss percent would have been 2.30%.
